# Copilot instructions (adapter)

Follow the harness-agnostic project instructions:

1. Repo-root `AGENTS.md`
2. Details in `docs/agents/` (especially `constraints.md` and `conventions.md`)
3. Portable skills in `skills/*/SKILL.md`

Do not duplicate OpenSwim conventions in this file. See `docs/agents/harness-map.md`.
